from: June book, night 2 (Ruth in Boaz’s Field)
p1: Ruth and Naomi needed food. Ruth said, “Let me go to the field and pick up grain.”
The Lord told farmers to leave some grain behind. It was “for the poor and the stranger,” people from far away. Then hungry people could eat too.
So Ruth went to the field of Boaz, from Naomi’s family. She picked up grain the workers left behind.
p2: Boaz said, “Stay in my field, and drink our water.” Ruth asked, “Why are you so kind to me?” Boaz had heard how Ruth loved Naomi. He told his workers to drop extra grain for her.
In a new place, Ruth found a kind helper. Tonight, thank Heavenly Father for your helpers. Tomorrow, be a kind helper too.
old: Ruth and Naomi needed food. Ruth said, “I will go work in the fields.” She went to pick up leftover grain that the workers dropped.
Ruth worked in a field that belonged to a kind man named Boaz. Boaz saw Ruth working hard. He told his workers, “Be extra kind to Ruth. Leave extra grain for her to find.”

At the end of the day, Ruth had lots of grain! She hurried home to show Naomi. Ruth worked hard all day to take care of Naomi. Ruth was humble and worked hard. Boaz was kind and generous. They both pleased Heavenly Father with their choices.
